nodes.name: .impeccable.md
nodes.summary: Design context brief for the Masterminds workshop site: defines the two audiences (workshop participants and giveaway visitors), a practical/premium/human brand personality, the dark-background cream-text purple/pink aesthetic, anti-luxury references, and six design principles emphasizing clarity for non-technical beginners.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus code-intelligence guidance for the workshop-site repo: mandates impact analysis before editing symbols, change detection before commits, risk warnings, and lists GitNexus MCP resources and CLI skill files for exploring, debugging, and refactoring.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude-facing GitNexus code-intelligence instructions for the workshop-site repo, mirroring AGENTS.md: required impact analysis and change detection, prohibitions on unsafe edits/renames, and a table of GitNexus resources and CLI skill references.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the masterminds-workshop Next.js 16 / React 19 site. Declares dev/build/start/lint/test scripts plus abandoned-checkout automation scripts, and dependencies including Stripe, Supabase, Resend, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Vanta, Lenis, and TypeScript/Tailwind tooling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the workshop site, defining compilerOptions plus include and exclude globs that control which files are type-checked during Next.js builds and tests.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment config: a host-based rewrite mapping decks.mastermindshq.business to the 2x-with-ai-playbook static page, and four cron schedules driving abandoned-checkout followups (daily and T+12h), location reminders, and registration reconciliation API routes.
